label: YouTube TV carriage dispute with Disney
note: Disney networks (ABC, ESPN, ESPN2, ESPNU, ESPNEWS, SEC Network, ACC Network) went dark on YouTube TV the night of Oct 30 2025 and returned once a new carriage deal was reached the evening of Fri Nov 14 2025, depressing ABC/ESPN viewership on that platform during the window.
